species.notes: 'Structure 2' -- found to be the MOST STABLE of the 3 isomers studied in this paper (both MP2/6-31G* and CCSD(T)/6-311G*).

bond_params.connectivity: Linear/zigzag open chain: azide(N1-N2-N3)-N4=N5-azide(N6-N7-N8); described in text as 'diazidodiimide, cis: N3-N=N-N3'.
bond_params.caveat: Symmetric values doubled by C2h symmetry (only one half of the molecule's distinct bonds shown, mirrored by inversion center). Read from labeled diagram image.

species.notes: 'Structure 3a' (cis diazidodiimide). Does NOT appear to match any existing corpus entry by name -- likely genuinely NEW topology. 2.9 kcal/mol more stable than trans isomer (3b) at MP2/6-31G*; 1.2 kcal/mol at CCSD(T)/6-311G*. ~17.5 kcal/mol above azidopentazole (structure 2) at MP2 level.

bond_params.connectivity: Same as 3a but trans conformation of the two azide side groups relative to the central N=N.
